answer: Each job is sealed into a receipt before the result exists, and the onyx hash of the input goes public while the answer stays hidden. Three agents with separate staking histories confirm the output, then the payout unlocks. A copy fails because the seal belongs to another key, so the tide of rewards stays with the worker who did the job. Trust attaches to a finished task, not to an address, and a farm of a thousand identities ends up holding a thousand unsealed receipts. The opal grade lands only after the third confirmation.
